niche: software, AI, build-in-public, and technical personal-brand content
purpose: Provide dated, source-backed platform strategy inputs for the Phase 0 manual Content Director. This snapshot is strategic guidance, not a guarantee of reach or views.
rules: Platform research may influence packaging, hook, pacing, format, and creative treatment only.
Platform research must never be used as evidence for factual project claims.
Do not state or imply guaranteed views, virality, reach, or algorithmic preference.
A human may override any strategy recommendation before approval.
The Phase 0 runtime reads this checked-in snapshot locally and performs no network research.

audience_intent: be entertained by a clear story or experiment
go deeper on a topic or creator
discover useful content through search and recommendations
current_distribution_signals: Recommendation performance can be reasoned about through appeal, engagement, and satisfaction.
Titles and thumbnails are important packaging for long-form videos.
The opening should quickly deliver on the title/thumbnail promise and sustain viewer interest.
Shorts are ranked by viewer personalization and performance rather than by a single favored format.
Long-form and Shorts audiences can overlap, but viewer preferences also vary by format.

long_form.goal: watch time, authority, returning viewers, and deeper project understanding
long_form.default_shape: problem-first title/thumbnail promise -> immediate hook -> story/experiment -> technical proof -> result -> lessons
long_form.duration_guidance: Use the shortest length that delivers the story and value without filler; do not hard-code an algorithmic ideal length.

shorts.default_shape: immediate curiosity/problem -> one core proof/demo -> payoff -> optional bridge to deeper content
shorts.duration_guidance: Keep it concise enough to preserve retention; choose length from the content rather than a fixed algorithm myth.

avoid: slow logo or branding intros before value
assuming one format is algorithmically favored
treating a Short as only a cropped excerpt with no self-contained value

audience_intent: discover visually compelling or useful short-form content
discover creators beyond the accounts they already follow
current_distribution_signals: Instagram increased the prevalence of original content in US recommendations, reaching 75% of recommendations from original posts in Q4 2025.
Reels and messaging are major discovery and sharing surfaces; Meta reports Reels are reshared more than 4.5 billion times per day across its platforms.
Trial Reels allow creators to test a Reel with non-followers before deciding whether to share more broadly.
Meta reports that among creators who posted more often after trying Trial Reels, many saw increased non-follower reach.
recommended_archetypes: builder story with a clear visual payoff

reels.goal: shares, saves, non-follower discovery, and profile interest
reels.default_shape: strong first-frame promise -> visually legible problem -> proof/demo -> clear payoff
reels.creative_guidance: Prioritize original RBL footage/screens/screenshots, readable text, clean visual hierarchy, and a reason someone would send or save the Reel.

avoid: dense technical explanation without visual hierarchy
a first frame that does not communicate the value or curiosity gap

audience_intent: follow curiosity into a topic or niche
see authentic process and behind-the-scenes stories
participate through comments, reactions, and community language
search for practical or unexpected answers
current_distribution_signals: TikTok's 2026 Reali-Tea signal emphasizes honesty, community, shared experience, unfiltered stories, and behind-the-scenes process over curated perfection.
The 2026 Curiosity Detours signal emphasizes discovery journeys, search, adjacent interests, and small interest-driven communities.
TikTok explicitly recommends treating comments and community participation as part of the creative surface.
The 2026 trend material highlights #joblife and real working/process stories as examples of grounded content.

vertical_video.goal: curiosity, completion, conversation, search discovery, and community connection
vertical_video.default_shape: conversational first-sentence hook -> real problem/process -> proof/demo -> satisfying result or open loop
vertical_video.creative_guidance: Prefer natural language, real process, screen/camera proof, and searchable phrasing over corporate polish.

avoid: overly curated ad-style storytelling when a real process story exists
generic trend-chasing unrelated to the project or audience
claims of guaranteed virality from using a trend
